summary: Configure explicit GitHub publication metadata for stack releases
description: The stack already names the GitHub release provider, remote, branch and repository, but the publication profile lacks the required version source, bump policy, tag prefix and changelog path. Add only this declarative profile using pyproject.toml project.version, patch bump, v-prefixed tags and CHANGELOG.md. This task does not bump the version or perform any remote write; the separate release task still requires explicit push authorization.
acceptance: GitHub release profile keeps provider=github-release, remote=origin, branch=main and repository=viggomeesters/go-workflow-stack, and adds a valid publication contract for pyproject.toml project.version with patch bump, v tag prefix and CHANGELOG.md.
The repo-local project schema and validate command accept the profile and existing release pairing/history remains unchanged.
Configuration alone does not bump a version, create a tag, push or publish; release.prepare still requires explicit task/run push authority.
